purpose: Discover model repositories, collections, spaces, model-tree links, and publisher namespaces for a specialized task surface.
Capture public model card metadata, revision identifiers, content hashes, and source pointers without copying private training data.
Parse pipeline tags, datasets, license fields, base model lineage, evaluation results, paper links, and model tree signals.
Normalize task shape, label schemas, input/output contracts, limitations, intended-use notes, and model replacement routes.
Link dataset cards, benchmark names, metrics, paper refs, and leaderboard sources to the candidate primitive graph.
Link publishers, model IDs, datasets, tasks, domains, organizations, and benchmark entities into canonical IDs.
Cluster duplicate or near-duplicate model-derived primitive candidates by task shape, labels, datasets, and limitations.
Emit keyword, vector, graph, facet, quality, and cost-route index records for model-derived primitives.
Route medical, legal, privacy, safety, licensing-sensitive, or high-impact model-derived primitives to curator review before promotion.
